Usa Financial Portformulas Lifted Wynn Resorts LTD (WYNN) Holding by $4.45 Million as Market Value Rose; Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) Stock Declined While Salzman & Company Cut Its Stake by $1.49 Million
May 17, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Usa Financial Portformulas Corp increased its stake in Wynn Resorts Ltd (WYNN) by 118.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Usa Financial Portformulas Corp bought 26,515 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.95% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 48,838 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.23M, up from 22,323 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Usa Financial Portformulas Corp who had been investing in Wynn Resorts Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $20.88B market cap company. The stock increased 1.23% or $2.34 during the last trading session, reaching $192.51. About 1.60 million shares traded. Wynn Resorts, Limited (NASDAQ:WYNN) has risen 55.02% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 43.47% the S&P500.
Salzman & Company decreased its stake in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) by 3.03% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Salzman & Company sold 45,025 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.44% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.44 million shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $48.70M, down from 1.48 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Salzman & Company who had been investing in Liberty Global Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $23.13B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.07% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $28.77. About 2.69 million shares traded. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYK) has declined 10.09% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.64% the S&P500.
